title: My work home
description: Keep your work context intact while tailoring the home composition to you.

overview.title: Home settings overview
overview.description: Review the active mode, saved home, device synchronization, and the next personalization action.
overview.deviceSummary_one: {{count}} device layout is synchronized for the active home.
overview.deviceSummary_other: {{count}} device layouts are synchronized for the active home.

common.unavailable: These settings are unavailable right now.

profiles.title: Homes for each work mode
profiles.description: Create up to ten homes and choose which one opens after sign-in.
profiles.activateBeforeEdit: Use this home before editing its layout.
profiles.empty: You have no personal homes yet. Save the current composition as your first home.
profiles.cannotDelete: The active or last remaining home cannot be deleted.

appearance.title: Home width and density
appearance.description: Choose a content width and spacing pattern for your work style and screen.
appearance.safety: Layout style adjusts spacing and visible information for the available width. Permissions, work data, semantic order, and keyboard order stay the same.

focused.title: Focused
focused.description: Narrows the canvas and uses compact spacing to keep attention on one task.

balanced.title: Balanced
balanced.description: Uses standard width and spacing to balance information and breathing room.

expressive.title: Wide
expressive.description: Minimizes side margins and uses large displays to show more information at once.

content.title: Widget content scope
content.description: Choose one to three summary rows for each purpose widget. Data access stays unchanged.

device.title: Device layouts
device.description: Tune density and widget sizes by device while preserving semantic order.

templates.title: Governed work templates
templates.description: Published templates apply as a personal copy, separate from the source and later edits.
templates.partial: More than {{limit}} templates exist. This view shows only the first page.
templates.applied: Template applied as a new version.

apply.title: Apply this template?
apply.description: {{name}} will replace this home's current layout as a new reversible version.

publish.title: Publish this template?
publish.description: {{name}} will become available to its configured audience.

revoke.title: Revoke this template?
revoke.description: {{name}} will no longer be available for new applications. Existing personal copies remain unchanged.

history.title: Version history
history.description: Restoring creates a new version instead of overwriting history.
history.empty: There is no saved version history yet.
history.partial: More than {{limit}} versions exist. This view shows only the newest first page.
history.restored: The selected version was restored as a new version.

ai.title: AI Workstyle Composer
ai.description: Create a proposal from the current layout and permitted signals without sending work content.
ai.unavailable: AI suggestions are disabled by your organization. Your saved homes and device layouts remain available.
ai.noChanges: Your current composition already fits this workstyle.
ai.warning: Managed App Dock, announcements, and Now regions will not change.
ai.applied: Only the approved changes were applied.
ai.undone: AI changes were restored to the previous version.

feedback.failed: The request could not be completed. Refresh the latest state and try again.
feedback.conflict: This home changed elsewhere. The latest version has been loaded.

modePreset.title: Choose a Home mode
modePreset.description: Choose what you want to see first and how you want to begin your work.
modePreset.selectionHelp: Select a mode to update the Home screen example.
modePreset.layoutPreservation: The order and access rights of {{count}} shared apps stay the same. Each mode also keeps its own layout and device settings.

CLASSIC.title: Classic · Organization portal
CLASSIC.description: A calm Home for browsing organization news, knowledge, and support information.

FLOW_V1.title: Flow · Work Home
FLOW_V1.description: An action-oriented Home for handling due work, schedules, and response requests by priority.

MZ_V1.title: AI Stage
MZ_V1.description: An AI-centered Home for turning intent into evidence and an actionable plan.
